analyzed_vuln.description: `get_coffset` calls `blosc_getitem(coffsets, nchunk, 1, offset)` on the offsets chunk returned by `get_coffsets` without validating that this chunk is a sane/valid Blosc buffer for the requested item index. For the PoC, malformed frame metadata yields a bogus `coffsets` pointer/contents, and `blosc_getitem` reaches `blosc_read_header`, which does `memcpy(header, src, BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH)` from an invalid address, causing the ASan wild read SEGV.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In `decompress_frame_fuzzer`, attacker-controlled input is passed to `blosc2_schunk_from_buffer`, then chunk decompression (`blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk` -> `frame_decompress_chunk` -> `frame_get_lazychunk` -> `get_coffset`) is attempted. A crafted frame with corrupted coffsets metadata can make `get_coffsets` provide invalid offsets data; because `get_coffset` does not robustly validate coffsets buffer integrity/size before calling `blosc_getitem`, header parsing dereferences invalid memory and crashes.
